name: Notional
lifecycle_note: Deprecated when Notional V3 launched (2023); the app still loads with a deprecation banner and points migrated positions to V3.
description: Notional V2 was Notional's fixed-rate lending protocol on Ethereum, where lenders and borrowers locked in rates through fCash markets. It was deprecated when Notional V3 launched; the old app at v2.notional.finance still loads with a deprecation banner and a link to migrated positions.
description_zh: Notional V2 是 Notional 在以太坊上的固定利率借贷协议，出借人和借款人通过 fCash 市场锁定利率。Notional V3 上线后它已被弃用；v2.notional.finance 上的旧应用仍可打开，显示弃用提示和已迁移头寸的链接。

tos.restricted: no terms linked from the app

notes: Deprecated; positions were migrated to V3.
live: v2.notional.finance (2026-10-10): app loads with 'Notional V2 is being deprecated' banner; the bundle has no geo or screening code
